path.aria-label: Akash Harmalkar, widely known as Akash Live, is a
professional live percussionist & drummer from Goa,
renowned for creating high-impact, visually stunning
performances. He is India’s only live percussionist who
also curates bespoke entertainment experiences with
his elite team of saxophonists & electric violinists.
He has performed for leading celebrities including
Ranveer Singh, Malaika Arora, Amrita Arora, Rakulpreet
Singh, Jackky Bhagnani, Viraj Ghelani & many more. A
graduate in music, he holds multiple certifications from
for setting trends in the live
